Game Overview

In Duoland, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a nostalgic treasure hunt in Duoland, navigating a pixelated island as two pirate siblings. Collect treasures, unlock chests, and work together or alone to reach the hidden pirate ship. Experience the excitement across diverse controls for a thrilling two-player adventure. Will you seize the ultimate prize?
